name: MySQL Workbench
about: Official visual tool for designing, querying and administering MySQL databases.

name: SQLite Browser
about: Simple visual tool for creating, browsing and editing SQLite database files.

name: Redis Insight
description: GUI for Redis and compatible databases
about: Graphical tool for exploring and debugging Redis data, with a command console and memory analysis.

name: HeidiSQL
description: Database client for MySQL, MariaDB and more
about: Lightweight client for managing MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQL Server databases.

name: Oracle VirtualBox
about: Free desktop virtualization software for running other operating systems in virtual machines. The core is open source; the extension pack is not.

name: QEMU
about: Open-source machine emulator and virtualizer. Powerful and flexible, mostly used from the command line.

name: Rancher Desktop
about: Local Kubernetes and container management on your desktop, with a choice of container engines.

name: Podman Desktop
about: Graphical app for managing containers and pods with Podman, as a daemonless alternative to Docker.

name: WinFsp
description: Windows File System Proxy for user-mode filesystems
about: Windows File System Proxy. Lets developers write file systems in user mode, and is required by several tools such as Cryptomator.

name: PowerShell 7
description: Modern cross-platform shell and scripting language
about: Modern cross-platform version of PowerShell for automation and scripting, separate from the Windows PowerShell 5.1 built into Windows.

name: Windows Terminal
about: Modern tabbed terminal for Windows that hosts PowerShell, Command Prompt and WSL, with GPU-accelerated text.

name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
about: Run Linux distributions directly on Windows without a separate virtual machine. Installing may require a restart.

name: Playnite
about: Open-source library manager that combines games from Steam, Epic, GOG and others into one launcher.

name: EA app
about: Electronic Arts' launcher for buying, installing and playing EA games.

name: Ubisoft Connect
about: Ubisoft's launcher and storefront for Ubisoft PC games, with cloud saves and rewards.

name: GOG Galaxy
about: GOG's launcher that can also combine libraries from other platforms. Games from GOG are DRM-free.

name: Battle.net
about: Blizzard's launcher for Blizzard games such as Overwatch, Diablo and World of Warcraft.

name: itch.io app
about: Desktop app for browsing, downloading and updating indie games and tools from itch.io.

name: Moonlight Game Streaming
about: Streams games from your gaming PC to another device over your network, using NVIDIA GameStream or Sunshine hosts.

name: Sunshine
about: Self-hosted game-stream host that works with Moonlight clients, an open-source alternative to NVIDIA GameStream.

name: Google Drive
about: Google's desktop app that syncs files with Google Drive and can stream them on demand.

name: Dropbox
about: Cloud file syncing client with sharing links and selective sync. The free plan has limited storage.

name: Microsoft OneDrive
about: Microsoft's cloud storage sync client, tightly integrated with Windows and Microsoft 365.

name: Nextcloud Desktop
about: Sync client for self-hosted Nextcloud servers, keeping a folder in step with your private cloud.

name: Proton Drive
about: Encrypted cloud storage from Proton with end-to-end encryption. The apps are open source.

name: LocalSend
about: Share files with nearby devices over your local network, with no internet or account needed. Works across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.

name: KDE Connect
description: Connect Windows PC and Android devices
about: Links your Windows PC and Android phone for notifications, file sharing, clipboard sync and remote input.

name: RustDesk
about: Open-source remote desktop software. Self-host your own server or use the public one, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

name: AnyDesk
about: Fast remote desktop application for support and remote access. Free for personal use.

name: TeamViewer
about: Widely used remote access and support tool. Free for personal use, with paid plans for business.

name: Notion
description: Workspace for notes, docs and projects
about: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis and project management. Free for personal use.

name: Microsoft Teams
about: Microsoft's chat, meeting and collaboration app, integrated with Microsoft 365.

name: Evernote
about: Note-taking and organization app with web clipping and search. Free tier has limits.

name: Free Download Manager
about: Download manager that speeds up and schedules downloads, with resume support and torrent handling.

name: JDownloader 2
about: Download manager that automates downloads from file-hosting sites. Some installers include optional offers, so read the prompts.

name: Transmission
about: Lightweight, easy-to-use BitTorrent client with a minimal interface.

name: Deluge
about: Light but extensible BitTorrent client with a plugin system and optional web interface.

name: Calmly Writer
about: Minimal distraction-free writing app with Markdown support and focus modes. Free with optional paid features.

name: ArtCraft Launcher
description: Launcher for the ArtCraft family of creative tools; official download page
about: Launcher for the ArtCraft family of creative tools. This entry opens the official download page so you can install it manually.

name: PhotoCraft
description: Raster image editor with layers and masks; early-stage software
about: Early-stage raster image editor with layers and masks, distributed through GitHub releases. Expect rough edges.

name: VectorCraft
description: Vector illustration and Bézier design tool
about: Early-stage vector illustration and Bézier design tool, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: FilmCraft
description: Video editing and timeline workflow tool
about: Early-stage video editor with a timeline workflow, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: LightCraft
description: Photo library and RAW development tool
about: Early-stage photo library and RAW development tool, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: EffectCraft
description: Motion graphics and visual effects compositor
about: Early-stage motion graphics and visual effects compositor, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: DesignCraft
about: Early-stage page layout and publishing tool, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: PdfCraft / PrintCraft
description: PDF viewing, organizing and protection workbench
about: Early-stage PDF workbench for viewing, organizing and protecting documents, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: WordCraft
description: Open-source word-processing project in the Craft family
about: Early-stage open-source word processor from the Craft family, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: GridCraft
description: Open-source spreadsheet project in the Craft family
about: Early-stage open-source spreadsheet application from the Craft family, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: DeckCraft
description: Open-source presentation project in the Craft family
about: Early-stage open-source presentation tool from the Craft family, distributed through GitHub releases.

name: SoundCraft
description: Open-source audio editing project in the Craft family
about: Early-stage open-source audio editor from the Craft family, distributed through GitHub releases.
